title: Miniature Logistic-Normal Multinomial Models
text: miniLNM lightweight package fitting using logistic-normal multinomial models. wraps simple Stan script (see inst/stan/ folder source code) defines S4 class makes easy specify, estimate, draw samples fit. example, can use tidyselect syntax relate multiple compositional outputs set influential biological factors. print method gives concise summary fitted model, easier read full Stan output. can also use predict, like ordinary linear models, can draw posterior predictive samples using sample.

title: Fit a logistic normal multinomial model using R's formula interface. — lnm
text: function fits logistic normal multinomial (LNM) model data using R's formula interface. LNM model generalization multinomial logistic regression model, allowing correlated responses within category response variable. can used learn relationship experimental/environmental factors community composition. statistical model estimates probabilities different outcomes multinomial distribution, given set covariates. LNM model assumes log-ratio outcome probabilities follow multivariate normal distribution. fitting LNM model observed data, can infer effects covariates outcome compositions.
